therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: CD38 targeting combined with immune checkpoint blockade
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Tumor cell targeting and T-cell activation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with advanced malignancies (HCC, SCCHN, EOC, GBM)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Safety (DLTs, MTD, RP2D) and preliminary efficacy (overall response rate, PFS-6 for GBM)

results.target_engagement_evidence: Isatuximab PK data showed target concentrations achieved with Cmax 218-266 mcg/mL across cohorts
biomarker_changes: Treatment-induced ADA against isatuximab in 4 participants
Treatment-induced ADA against atezolizumab in 5 participants
subgroup_findings: Best response rates varied by tumor type
GBM cohort showed particularly poor outcomes
safety_signals: Liver function abnormalities in HCC cohort
results.dose_information: Isatuximab 10 mg/kg + Atezolizumab (dose not specified), 21-day cycles

context.investigator_commentary: Study was terminated - limited efficacy observed across tumor types with particularly poor outcomes in GBM cohort
